**SECTION D: COMPOSITION WRITING**

Write a composition of between 250-300 words on ONE of the following topics:

questions.enonce_markdown:
1. There have been power cuts in your neighbourhood. Sometimes you go for weeks without electricity. This situation is affecting your studies and your family life negatively. Write a letter of complaint to the Manager of AES SONEL about the power cuts and how they are affecting you. In your letter, talk about the frequency of these cuts, the consequences on you, your family and the community as a whole.

Your name is Togi and your address is G.H.S. Warda, P.O. Box 2222, Gari Gombo.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Une lettre formelle de réclamation ("letter of complaint") suit une mise en page et un registre codifiés : adresse de l'expéditeur en haut, date, adresse ou titre du destinataire, formule d'appel formelle ("Dear Sir/Madam" ou "Dear Manager"), objet clairement énoncé dès le premier paragraphe, corps structuré autour des points imposés par le sujet, demande explicite d'action, formule de politesse formelle de clôture ("Yours faithfully") et signature. Le registre reste soutenu et factuel, sans familiarité ni emportement excessif, même si le sujet est une plainte.

**Structure attendue :** adresse de l'expéditeur -> date -> formule d'appel -> paragraphe d'introduction énonçant l'objet de la lettre -> fréquence des coupures -> conséquences sur les études et la vie familiale -> conséquences sur la communauté -> demande explicite d'amélioration -> formule de clôture et signature. Les trois points imposés par le sujet (fréquence, conséquences sur soi/sa famille, conséquences sur la communauté) doivent chacun apparaître clairement.

**Modèle de rédaction (anglais), environ 280 mots :**

Togi

G.H.S. Warda

P.O. Box 2222

Gari Gombo

12th June 2024

The Manager

AES SONEL

Gari Gombo

Dear Sir,

**Subject: Complaint about frequent power cuts in Gari Gombo**

I am writing to bring to your attention a serious problem that has been affecting my neighbourhood for several months now: frequent and prolonged power cuts.

Over the past few months, electricity has been cut off almost every week, and sometimes we go for two to three weeks without any power supply at all. These cuts often happen without any prior warning from your company, which makes it impossible for us to plan around them.

This situation is seriously affecting my studies. As a student preparing for my Baccalaureat examination, I need light in the evenings to revise my lessons, and the lack of electricity has forced me to study by candlelight on many occasions, which is both uncomfortable and unsafe. My family is also affected: my mother's small provision shop, which depends on a refrigerator to keep goods fresh, has lost a great deal of stock because of these constant power cuts.

Beyond my own household, the whole community of Gari Gombo suffers as well. Small businesses that depend on electricity are losing customers and income, and the health centre nearby struggles to preserve medicines that require refrigeration.

I would therefore like to request that AES SONEL look into this matter urgently and take the necessary steps to provide a more stable and reliable power supply to our neighbourhood. I would also appreciate it if your company could inform residents in advance whenever planned power cuts are necessary.

I look forward to your prompt response and to an improvement in the situation.

Yours faithfully,

Togi

### Piège à éviter
Ne rédige pas une lettre personnelle avec un ton familier ("Hi", "Bye") : une lettre de réclamation à un responsable d'entreprise exige les formules formelles "Dear Sir/Madam" et "Yours faithfully", jamais "Dear friend" ou "Best wishes".

### Conseil
Mentionne toujours les coordonnées imposées par le sujet (ici le nom "Togi" et l'adresse complète) exactement comme elles sont données, en tête de lettre : le correcteur vérifie que l'identité fournie dans la consigne est bien reprise.

questions.enonce_markdown: 2. Farmers of your village have more and more difficulties in carrying out their activities as days go by. The seasons keep on changing and the rainy seasons during which they used to plant their seeds have become unpredictable. The situation affects the whole chain of food production. Write an essay on the causes, consequences of climate change, and provide some solutions to prevent it in the society.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Quand un sujet impose une liste de points à traiter (ici causes, conséquences, solutions), la rédaction doit suivre cet ordre en un paragraphe distinct par point, avec une courte introduction qui situe le problème et une conclusion qui ouvre sur l'engagement collectif. C'est une rédaction guidée et informative, pas une dissertation argumentative avec thèse/antithèse : chaque paragraphe reste factuel et développe uniquement le point qui lui est assigné.

**Structure attendue :** introduction qui situe le dérèglement des saisons décrit dans le sujet -> causes du changement climatique -> conséquences sur l'agriculture et la production alimentaire -> solutions pour en réduire les effets -> courte conclusion d'ouverture. Chaque point du sujet devient un paragraphe séparé, dans l'ordre indiqué.

**Modèle de rédaction (anglais), environ 290 mots :**

**Climate Change and Its Effects on Farming**

For many years now, farmers in our village have noticed that the seasons no longer follow the pattern they used to know. The rainy season, during which planting is usually done, has become shorter and more unpredictable, and this is disturbing the entire chain of food production. This essay looks at the causes of this problem, its consequences, and possible solutions.

The main cause of these changes in season is climate change, itself caused by human activities. The excessive cutting down of trees around farms and villages reduces the amount of rainfall an area receives. The burning of bushes before farming releases smoke and gases into the air, and, on a larger scale, pollution from factories and vehicles around the world is gradually warming up the planet, which disturbs normal rainfall patterns everywhere, including in our village.

The consequences of these changes are already visible in the fields. Crops that need steady and predictable rainfall, such as maize and cassava, are producing smaller harvests than before. Some farmers have lost entire plantations because the rains stopped earlier than expected. If nothing is done, our village risks facing serious food shortages and rising food prices in the years to come.

However, several solutions can help reduce these effects. First, farmers should plant more trees around their farms and along riverbanks, since trees help to attract rainfall and protect the soil from erosion. Second, adopting quick-maturing crop varieties and simple irrigation methods, such as wells or water reservoirs, can help farmers cope with shorter rainy seasons. Third, avoiding the burning of bushes and composting dead leaves instead can enrich the soil naturally without harming the atmosphere.

Climate change is a real and pressing challenge for farming communities like ours, but through collective action today, we can protect our farms and secure the harvests of tomorrow.

### Piège à éviter
Ne mélange pas les causes (déforestation, pollution) et les conséquences (mauvaises récoltes, pénuries alimentaires) dans le même paragraphe : ce sont deux points distincts demandés séparément par le sujet, et les confondre fait perdre des points sur les deux critères à la fois.

### Conseil
Donne un titre à ton essai même si le sujet ne l'impose pas explicitement : un titre clair montre au correcteur que tu maîtrises la structure attendue d'un essai informatif guidé.

questions.enonce_markdown: 3. There is an outbreak of cholera currently going on in your area, Wawa. As the president of the Health Committee, you have been selected to sensitise the people on how to prevent cholera. Write a speech in which you describe the mode of transmission of cholera, its symptoms and how it could be prevented.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un discours formel ("formal speech") s'adresse à un public réuni pour une occasion précise. Il s'ouvre par une formule d'adresse au public, développe les points annoncés dans la consigne dans un ordre logique, et se termine par un remerciement ou un appel à l'action. Le registre reste soutenu ("ladies and gentlemen", "dear neighbours"), sans contractions ni familiarité, même si le sujet est une simple sensibilisation de quartier.

**Structure attendue :** formule d'adresse au public -> présentation de soi et de l'objet du discours -> mode de transmission du choléra -> symptômes -> mesures de prévention -> appel à l'action collective -> remerciement final. Le sujet impose trois points précis (transmission, symptômes, prévention) : chacun doit apparaître clairement, dans cet ordre ou un ordre proche.

**Modèle de rédaction (anglais), environ 270 mots :**

Dear neighbours, ladies and gentlemen,

Good morning, and thank you all for gathering here today. As the president of the Health Committee of Wawa, I stand before you with an urgent matter: the outbreak of cholera currently affecting our area.

Cholera is a disease caused by bacteria that spread mainly through contaminated water and food. It is transmitted when we drink water that has not been properly treated, or when we eat food prepared or washed with dirty water, especially in places where toilets are close to wells or streams. It can also spread when an infected person does not wash their hands properly after using the toilet and then touches food or water that others will consume.

The symptoms of cholera appear quickly and can be very dangerous if not treated in time. They include severe watery diarrhoea, vomiting, and rapid dehydration, which can cause weakness, dizziness and, in serious cases, death within hours if the patient is not treated.

Fortunately, cholera can be prevented through simple daily habits. We should always boil or treat our drinking water before use, wash our hands thoroughly with soap after using the toilet and before eating, keep our toilets far from wells and water sources, and wash fruits and vegetables properly before eating them. If anyone shows symptoms of cholera, they should go to the nearest health centre immediately rather than trying to treat themselves at home, since quick rehydration can save lives.

I therefore call on each and every one of you to apply these simple measures and to spread this information to your families and neighbours. Together, we can stop this outbreak and protect our community.

Thank you very much for your attention.

### Piège à éviter
Ne confonds pas les symptômes du choléra (diarrhée, vomissements, déshydratation) avec son mode de transmission (eau et aliments contaminés) : le sujet demande explicitement les deux points séparément, et les mélanger dans un seul paragraphe fait perdre des points au barème.

### Conseil
Dans un discours de sensibilisation sanitaire, termine toujours par un appel à l'action clair ("I call on each of you to...") plutôt que par une simple liste d'informations : c'est ce qui distingue un discours d'un exposé et rapporte des points sur le critère de la fonction communicative du texte.
